topology_note: SW2 is a 2960 switch. Fa0/10 was supposed to be in VLAN 40 (Guest, 10.10.40.0/24). Router-on-a-stick R1 provides inter-VLAN routing on Gi0/0 subinterfaces.
expected_fault: VLAN 40 has not been created on SW2 (it does not appear in show vlan brief), so the port is assigned to a non-existent VLAN and all traffic is dropped.
